cost: script O(n*m) time and memory for line counts; apply O(n log drops+output bytes). tree_words O(n²) worst-case head walks. Table selection computes four scripts; costs used for selection differ from later copier-based actual charge. Full annotation/frames costs unmeasured.
description: find_sentence chooses exact block then Given/Unparsed then nonempty span then literal. CoNLL-U encoder compares aligned token rows and stores fields; decoder re-annotates using same resources. tree_words validates sequential ids, known relations, heads and acyclicity. Chain holds continuation/fresh readings; table chooses minimum script_bits among reset/short alternatives with strict tie retention. script computes LCS with insertion tie. damage removes first stored item; run compares decoded pieces and clears exact_ok on first difference.
